data.title: About Gani
data.body: Property expertise with a personal approach, right here in Balham.

data.title: Independent advice, built around you
data.body:
As an independent agent and a member of the National Association of Estate Agents, we aim to make every part of your property journey clear, accurate and straightforward. Our website is updated regularly so the information you need is useful and current.
We cover sales, lettings, property management, land, new home development and buy-to-let across Balham and the surrounding areas.
Because we are independent, our service is personal and flexible. You will receive honest guidance, focused marketing and a team that remains accountable from your first conversation through to completion or move-in.
data.card_body: We are confident in the value we provide. We aim to beat any comparable agency fee while delivering a higher quality of service for you and your property.

data.title: Property services under one roof
data.intro: From a first appraisal to long-term management, our team brings local knowledge and practical support to every instruction.

cards.title: Residential sales
cards.text: Accurate valuations, considered presentation, broad marketing and skilled negotiation designed to secure the right buyer and the best possible outcome.

cards.title: Lettings
cards.text: Support for landlords and tenants from marketing and viewings through referencing, agreements, deposits and a smooth move-in.

cards.title: Property management
cards.text: Responsive day-to-day management, rent collection, maintenance coordination and regular communication for greater peace of mind.

cards.title: Land & development
cards.text: Local insight for landowners, developers and investors considering development opportunities, site potential and routes to market.

cards.title: New homes
cards.text: Positioning and sales support for new-build homes, from launch strategy and buyer enquiries to reservations and completion.

cards.title: Buy-to-let
cards.text: Practical guidance for landlords and investors, informed by local demand, achievable rental values and long-term market potential.

data.title: Clear communication at every step
data.body: Property decisions can be significant. Our role is to make the process easier to understand and easier to manage, with advice shaped by your priorities.

items.title: A realistic starting point
items.text: Thoughtful, evidence-led advice on value, timing and presentation.

items.title: Marketing that earns attention

items.title: One accountable local team
items.text: Consistent updates and proactive progression from instruction to completion.

data.title: At home in Balham and beyond
